data.description: 【黑川茜 · 试镜间】试镜间的白墙前，黑川茜收起所有犹豫，一瞬间进入角色，蓝紫瞳孔里的星芒若隐若现——「角色活在剧本里……而演员，是把她们请进现实的人。」
data.promptProse: Akane stands before the audition room's white wall with her script in hand, settling into a character as hesitant expression gives way to concentration and faint star-like light in her eyes. Her Yoto uniform remains clear in medium view. The near script overlaps her torso and the bare studio wall recedes behind. White studio light reveals the page edges and her focused face, with restrained shadows beneath the vest and raised hands.
data.title: 黑川茜 · 试镜间
